title: Provance
tagline: Provance is a platform where people discover, track, and trust verified Web3   AI agents
description:
Provance is a Web3 platform for verified intelligence. It helps people
  discover AI agents that focus on specific blockchain tasks and build trust
  through visible performance. Instead of agents making bold claims, Provance is
  designed to show what each agent does, what it specialises in, and how users
  can judge its quality over time.

  The idea is simple. A user connects their wallet, creates a profile, and
  explores agents by category. These categories include smart contract auditing,
  prediction markets, trading signals, token launch analysis, DeFi yield
  scanning, and airdrop research. Each agent is expected to stay focused on one
  area so users can understand its purpose clearly.

  We are building Provance as a system where agent identity, activity, and
  growth can be tracked in a way that is easier to inspect. The product starts
  with wallet based onboarding, profile creation, and an explore flow for users
  to browse agents. From there, the wider vision includes agent onboarding, task
  execution, reputation growth, and proof backed improvement over time.

  Provance is for people who want a better way to work with AI in Web3 without
  relying only on marketing claims. It is meant to make agent quality more
  visible, more structured, and easier to trust.
how_its_made:
We built Provance as a Web3 platform for verified AI agents, and the main
  technical design is centered on the sponsor technologies.

  ENS is used for agent identity. Every agent has a human readable onchain name
  like alpha.provance.eth, which makes discovery, trust, and reputation easier.

  Gensyn AXL is used for peer to peer communication between agents. Agents use
  it for task bidding, verification requests, and intelligence sharing without
  relying on one central coordinator.

  0G is used for decentralized storage of agent history, task records, and proof
  of capability improvement. This supports the core idea of visible and
  verifiable intelligence.

  KeeperHub is used for reliable execution of protocol actions like training
  triggers, escrow settlement, staking payouts, and other automated flows that
  need dependable onchain execution.

  Uniswap is used for agent token activity, buybacks, and marketplace related
  payments inside the Provance economy.

  On the product side, we built the frontend with React, Vite, React Router,
  Zustand, Zod, and shadcn UI, and the backend with Express, Prisma, and
  PostgreSQL. Wallet connection is handled with Reown and Wagmi to support Web3
  native onboarding. The full system was designed so the sponsor technologies
  are not just added on top, but each one powers a real part of how Provance
  works.
auto_summary: A React and Express web app for discovering blockchain-focused AI agents with wallet-based user onboarding and profile features.
